info.name: Get an array of asset-balances for an account.

params.name: accountId
params.description: SS58 address of the account.

params.name: at
params.description: Block at which to query asset-balance info for the specified account.

params.name: useRcBlock
params.description: When set to 'true', uses the relay chain block specified in the 'at' parameter to determine corresponding Asset Hub block(s). Only supported for Asset Hub endpoints. When used, returns an array of response objects (one for each Asset Hub block found) or empty array if none found.

params.name: useRcBlockFormat
params.description: Controls the response format when using 'useRcBlock=true'. When set to 'object', wraps the response in an object containing relay chain block info ('rcBlock') and the parachain data array ('parachainDataPerBlock'). When set to 'array' or omitted, returns the standard array format. Only valid when 'useRcBlock=true' is specified.

params.name: assets
params.description: An array of AssetId's to be queried. If not supplied, defaults to providing all asset balances associated with the `accountId` will be returned. The array query param format follows Express 4.x API. ex:`?assets[]=1&assets[]=2&assets[]=3`.

items.docs: Returns information about an account's asset-balances. This is specific to the assets pallet for parachains. If no `assets` query parameter is provided, all asset-balances for the given account will be returned.

info.name: Get balance information for an account.

params.name: accountId
params.description: SS58 address of the account.

params.name: at
params.description: Block at which to query balance info for the specified account.

params.name: useRcBlock
params.description: When set to 'true', uses the relay chain block specified in the 'at' parameter to determine corresponding Asset Hub block(s) for retrieving balance info. Only supported for Asset Hub endpoints. Requires 'at' parameter to specify the relay chain block. When used, returns an array of response objects (one for each Asset Hub block found) or empty array if none found.

params.name: useRcBlockFormat
params.description: Controls the response format when using 'useRcBlock=true'. When set to 'object', wraps the response in an object containing relay chain block info ('rcBlock') and the parachain data array ('parachainDataPerBlock'). When set to 'array' or omitted, returns the standard array format. Only valid when 'useRcBlock=true' is specified.

params.name: token
params.description: Token to query the balance of. If not specified it will query the chains native token (e.g. DOT for Polkadot). Note: this is only relevant for chains that support multiple tokens through the ORML tokens pallet.

params.name: denominated
params.description: When set to `true` it will denominate any balance's given atomic value using the chains given decimal value.

items.docs: Returns information about an account's balance. Replaces `/balance/{address}` from versions < v1.0.0.

info.name: Convert a given AccountId to an SS58 address.

params.name: accountId
params.description: AccountId or Public Key (hex).

params.name: scheme
params.description: The cryptographic scheme to be used in order to convert the AccountId to an SS58 address. It can take one of three values [sr25519, ed25519, ecdsa]. The default scheme that is used is `sr25519` (if it is not set in the query parameter).

params.name: prefix
params.description: The address prefix which can be one of the values found in the SS58-registry.

params.name: publicKey
params.description: Defines if the given value in the path parameter is a Public Key (hex) or not (hence AccountId).

items.docs: Returns the SS58 prefix, the network address format, the SS58 address, and the AccountId that was given as input parameter, the scheme that was used and if it is a public key or not (boolean).

params.name: addresses
params.description: An array or a comma separated string of SS58 addresses. Provide up to 30 addresses using one of these formats `?addresses=...&addresses=...` or `?addresses[]=...&addresses[]=...` or `?addresses=...,...`.

items.docs: Returns if the given addresses are equal or not, along with details of each address. Equality is determined by comparing the accountId/publicKey of each address.
